children: New York, September 22, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has downgraded the corporate family rating of Stonepeak Nile Parent LLC to Ba2 from Ba1 and the ratings on its backed senior secured debt and bank credit facilities to Ba2 from Ba1. Stonepeak is the parent company of Air Transport Services Group, Inc.. The issuer outlook remains negative.

title: Moody's Ratings downgrades Stonepeak Nile Parent LLC's CFR and secured debt ratings to Ba2; outlook remains negative
